rendered: According to the review, the recommended coating thickness of tens of nanometers for low-diffusivity oxides such as ZrO2 is because some coating materials which are generally quite inert and stable (e.g. ZrO2 or Al2O3) may react with lithium ions and form secondary phases (e.g. Li2ZrO3) resulting in capacity fading issues.
